description: Defines structures and functions related to PRACH preamble information in 5G NR, including parameters, retrieval functions for long and short preamble info, window duration, and duration calculations, following 3GPP TS38.211 specifications.

classes.name: prach_preamble_information
classes.description: Contains parameters for PRACH preamble, including sequence length, subcarrier spacing, number of symbols, CP length, and support for restricted sets.

classes.name: prach_symbols_slots_duration
classes.description: Holds duration details of PRACH preamble in slots, symbols, and starting positions.

methods.name: symbol_length
methods.description: Calculates the duration of a symbol in seconds based on the number of symbols and subcarrier spacing.
